Nothing else — not your confidence, not a critic's endorsement, not a plausible\n> story — promotes a claim to a fact.\n\nThe standing doctrine every reasoning call operates under is\n[framework/cognitive/metacognition.md](../../../framework/cognitive/metacognition.md) (it is\ninjected into every LLM system prompt). The binding\nconstitution is [CLAUDE.md](../../../CLAUDE.md); never relax scope, destruction, evidence, or\nhonesty rules.\n\n## The invariants (never violate these)\n\n1. **Oracle authority.** Only a fired oracle confirms. Critics/RL/reflection/self-consistency\n   may only *advise, re-rank, defer, or abstain* — never promote a finding or override the oracle.\n2. **Coverage.** Never silently skip an authorized attack surface. Hard limits (scope, authorization, destruction, real user data) are\n   inviolable — when unsure, stop and ask.\n6. **Determinism + append-only.** No wallclock/global-rng in learning/reward math; the event\n   spine is append-only (supersede, never edit).\n\n## Structured workflows\n\n### Run an authorized engagement (end-to-end, gated)\n1. Confirm the active target's `targets/<slug>/charter.md` authorizes it (constitution §II).\n2. `python3 -m framework.v2 engage <slug> <seed-url> [--recon] [--spine]`\n   — crawls, audits, confirms via oracles, chains attack paths, scores confidence, and\n   (with `--spine`) mirrors the whole run onto the immutable blackboard event stream.\n   (`--strict-evidence` is a **`scan`**-only flag, below — not an `engage` flag.)\n3. Enforces a\n2\tminimum interval between requests to the SAME host (keyed on the normalized host from ScrapeScope, so\n3\ttwo spellings can't split a host's budget), serialized per host (concurrency 1/host). The site's\n4\trobots `crawl-delay` raises the interval (`max(our_min, site_delay)`). The clock + sleep are\n5\tinjectable so tests assert the COMPUTED wait deterministically without real sleeping. This is\n6\tPOLITENESS, never evasion — throttling protects the third party, per doctrine §VI.\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\timport threading\n10\timport time\n11\tfrom typing import Callable, Dict\n12\t\n13\t\n14\tclass RateLimiter:\n15\t    def __init__(self, min_interval: float = 1.0, *,\n16\t                 clock: Callable[[], float] = time.monotonic,\n17\t                 sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep):\n18\t        self.min_interval = float(min_interval)\n19\t        self._clock = clock\n20\t        self._sleep = sleep\n21\t        self._last: Dict[str, float] = {}\n22\t        self._locks: Dict[str, threading.Lock] = {}\n23\t        self._guard = threading.Lock()\n24\t\n25\t    def _lock_for(self, host: str) -> threading.Lock:\n26\t        with self._guard:\n27\t            return self._locks.setdefault(host, threading.Lock())\n28\t\n29\t    def wait_time(self, host: str, *, host_min: float = 0.0) -> float:\n30\t        \"\"\"The seconds a request to `host` must wait right now (does not mutate). `host_min` = the\n31\t        site's crawl-delay, which raises the floor.\"\"\"\n32\t        interval = max(self.min_interval, float(host_min))\n33\t        last = self._last.get(host)\n34\t        if last is None:\n35\t            return 0.0\n36\t        return max(0.0, interval - (self._clock() - last))\n37\t\n38\t    def acquire(self, host: str, *, host_min: float = 0.0) -> float:\n39\t        \"\"\"Block (via the injected sleep) until it is polite to fetch `host`; record the fetch time.\n40\t        Returns the seconds actually waited. Serialized per host.\"\"\"\n41\t        with self._lock_for(host):\n42\t            wait = self.wait_time(host, host_min=host_min)\n43\t            if wait > 0:\n44\t                self._sleep(wait)\n45\t            self._last[host] = self._clock()\n46\t            return wait\n47\t"}]},"uuid":"4eca8d71-34f6-4e9b-a30f-0a04f54253aa","timestamp":"2026-07-18T20:58:37.582Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"0c5320d4-e18c-4471-ade0-65a712c916fc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Doctrine: respect, NEVER\n2\tevade — a Disallowed URL is dropped (recorded as a skip), never fetched, and the site's crawl-delay\n3\traises our rate-limit floor. robots.txt is fetched via the SSRF-gated `sources.fetch_raw` (NOT\n4\t`RobotFileParser.read()`, which would make its own UN-vetted, un-pinned request — an SSRF hole).\n5\tFail-closed on ambiguity: a 5xx/429/401/403/network robots → treat the whole host as disallow-all for\n6\tthis run; a 404/empty robots → allow-all (standard). Cached per host for the run. Stdlib parser, no dep.\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\tfrom typing import Callable\n10\tfrom urllib.parse import urlsplit\n11\tfrom urllib.robotparser import RobotFileParser\n12\t\n13\tfrom ..agents.sources import UA, fetch_raw\n14\t\n15\t_ALLOW_ALL = \"allow-all\"\n16\t_DISALLOW_ALL = \"disallow-all\"\n17\t\n18\t\n19\tclass RobotsCache:\n20\t    def __init__(self, *, fetch: Callable = fetch_raw, ua: str = UA):\n21\t        self._fetch = fetch\n22\t        self._ua = ua\n23\t        self._cache: dict = {}\n24\t\n25\t    def _rules_for(self, scheme: str, host: str):\n26\t        key = (scheme, host)\n27\t        if key in self._cache:\n28\t            return self._cache[key]\n29\t        res = self._fetch(f\"{scheme}://{host}/robots.txt\")\n30\t        rules = self._classify(res)\n31\t        self._cache[key] = rules\n32\t        return rules\n33\t\n34\t    def _classify(self, res):\n35\t        st = res.status\n36\t        if st == 0 or 500 <= st < 600 or st in (401, 403, 429):\n37\t            return _DISALLOW_ALL                       # ambiguous/blocked → fail-closed (polite + safe)\n38\t        if st == 404 or not (res.raw or \"\").strip():\n39\t            return _ALLOW_ALL                          # missing/empty robots → allowed (standard)\n40\t        if res.ok:\n41\t            rp = RobotFileParser()\n42\t            rp.parse((res.raw or \"\").splitlines())\n43\t            return rp\n44\t        return _ALLOW_ALL                              # other 4xx → allowed (RFC)\n45\t\n46\t    def can_fetch(self, url: str) -> bool:\n47\t        p = urlsplit(url)\n48\t        rules = self._rules_for(p.scheme, (p.hostname or \"\").lower())\n49\t        if rules == _DISALLOW_ALL:\n50\t            return False\n51\t        if rules == _ALLOW_ALL:\n52\t            return True\n53\t        return rules.can_fetch(self._ua, url)\n54\t\n55\t    def crawl_delay(self, url: str) -> float:\n56\t        p = urlsplit(url)\n57\t        rules = self._rules_for(p.scheme, (p.hostname or \"\").lower())\n58\t        if not isinstance(rules, RobotFileParser):\n59\t            return 0.0\n60\t        try:\n61\t            d = rules.crawl_delay(self._ua)\n62\t        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n63\t            return 0.0\n64\t        return float(d) if d else 0.0\n65\t"}]},"uuid":"1de4576d-54f1-47e9-8880-f6bcb536593f","timestamp":"2026-07-18T20:58:38.077Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"48a0d1b6-6d37-47d5-a714-ed7396567178","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Relative hrefs resolved against `base_url`; junk schemes dropped.\"\"\"\n42\t    p = _LinkParser()\n43\t    try:\n44\t        p.feed(html or \"\")\n45\t    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — malformed HTML must not crash a crawl\n46\t        pass\n47\t    out = []\n48\t    for href, text in p.links:\n49\t        try:\n50\t            absu = urljoin(base_url, href)\n51\t        except ValueError:\n52\t            continue\n53\t        if absu.startswith((\"http://\", \"https://\")):\n54\t            out.append({\"url\": absu, \"text\": text})\n55\t    return out\n56\t\n57\t\n58\tclass _TableParser(HTMLParser):\n59\t    def __init__(self):\n60\t        super().__init__()\n61\t        self.tables: List[List[List[str]]] = []\n62\t        self._t = self._r = None\n63\t        self._buf: List[str] = []\n64\t\n65\t    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):\n66\t        if tag == \"table\":\n67\t            self._t = []\n68\t        elif tag == \"tr\" and self._t is not None:\n69\t            self._r = []\n70\t        elif tag in (\"td\", \"th\") and self._r is not None:\n71\t            self._buf = []\n72\t\n73\t    def handle_data(self, data):\n74\t        if self._r is not None:\n75\t            self._buf.append(data)\n76\t\n77\t    def handle_endtag(self, tag):\n78\t        if tag in (\"td\", \"th\") and self._r is not None:\n79\t            self._r.append(\" \".join(\"\".join(self._buf).split()))\n80\t            self._buf = []\n81\t        elif tag == \"tr\" and self._r is not None:\n82\t            self._t.append(self._r); self._r = None\n83\t        elif tag == \"table\" and self._t is not None:\n84\t            self.tables.append(self._t); self._t = None\n85\t\n86\t\n87\tdef tables(html: str) -> List[List[List[str]]]:\n88\t    p = _TableParser()\n89\t    try:\n90\t        p.feed(html or \"\")\n91\t    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n92\t        pass\n93\t    return p.tables\n94\t\n95\t\n96\tdef main_text(html: str) -> str:\n97\t    return _strip_html(html or \"\")\n98\t\n99\t\n100\tdef entities(text: str, *, limit: int = 40) -> List[str]:\n101\t    \"\"\"Advisory candidate entities: salient tokens + capitalized runs. NOT facts.\"\"\"\n102\t    import re\n103\t    caps = re.findall(r\"\\b([A-Z][\\w'-]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][\\w'-]+){0,3})\\b\", text or \"\")\n104\t    out: List[str] = []\n105\t    seen = set()\n106\t    for c in caps:\n107\t        k = c.lower()\n108\t        if k not in seen and len(c) >= 3:\n109\t            seen.add(k); out.append(c)\n110\t    for t in sorted(salient(text or \"\")):\n111\t        if t not in seen:\n112\t            seen.add(t); out.append(t)\n113\t    return out[:limit]\n114\t"}]},"uuid":"03ec0a06-75ee-4235-92ab-cc3ada359b50","timestamp":"2026-07-18T20:58:38.333Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"18eef0de-d9d4-4753-9e75-1446a6b73204","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Every candidate passes\n2\tScrapeScope (deny-all + public-only) → robots (respected) → per-host rate limit → SSRF-gated\n3\t`fetch_raw` BEFORE a socket opens. Value-of-information ranking (question ↔ anchor+URL-path salient\n4\toverlap, minus a depth penalty) spends the page budget on the pages most likely to GROUND an answer,\n5\tnot blind BFS. Hard caps (max_pages/depth/per-host) + a normalized `seen` set kill runaway crawls and\n6\tcycles. Every dropped URL is recorded (robots-skip / out-of-scope / per-host-cap / fetch-error) — a\n7\tsilent cap would misrepresent coverage.\"\"\"\n8\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n9\t\n10\timport heapq\n11\timport itertools\n12\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\n13\tfrom typing import Callable, List, Optional, Tuple\n14\tfrom urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlencode, urlsplit, urlunsplit\n15\t\n16\tfrom ..agents.sources import fetch_raw\n17\tfrom ..consolidate.gate import salient\n18\tfrom ..reuse import sha256_hex\n19\tfrom . import extract\n20\tfrom .ratelimit import RateLimiter\n21\tfrom .robots import RobotsCache\n22\tfrom .scope import ScrapeScope\n23\t\n24\t\n25\tdef _norm_url(url: str) -> str:\n26\t    p = urlsplit(url)\n27\t    q = urlencode(sorted(parse_qsl(p.query)))\n28\t    return urlunsplit((p.scheme, p.netloc.lower(), p.path or \"/\", q, \"\"))     # drop fragment, sort query\n29\t\n30\t\n31\tdef _voi(qtok: set, url: str, anchor: str, depth: int) -> float:\n32\t    path = urlsplit(url).path.replace(\"/\", \" \").replace(\"-\", \" \").replace(\"_\", \" \")\n33\t    cand = salient(anchor) | salient(path)\n34\t    return len(qtok & cand) - 0.5 * depth\n35\t\n36\t\n37\t@dataclass\n38\tclass FetchedPage:\n39\t    url: str\n40\t    status: int\n41\t    text: str                      # readable (HTML-stripped) text — what a synthesizer sees\n42\t    raw: str                       # raw body (for extraction)\n43\t    content_hash: str\n44\t    depth: int\n45\t    links: List[dict] = field(default_factory=list)\n46\t\n47\t\n48\tclass Frontier:\n49\t    def __init__(self, scope: ScrapeScope, *, rate: Optional[RateLimiter] = None,\n50\t                 robots: Optional[RobotsCache] = None, fetch: Callable = fetch_raw,\n51\t                 max_pages: int = 25, max_depth: int = 3, max_per_host: int = 15):\n52\t        self.scope = scope\n53\t        self.rate = rate or RateLimiter()\n54\t        self.robots = robots or RobotsCache()\n55\t        self._fetch = fetch\n56\t        self.max_pages, self.max_depth, self.max_per_host = max_pages, max_depth, max_per_host\n57\t        self.skips: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []\n58\t\n59\t    def crawl(self, question: str, seeds: List[str]) -> List[FetchedPage]:\n60\t        qtok = salient(question)\n61\t        heap: list = []\n62\t        seen: set = set()\n63\t        per_host: dict = {}\n64\t        tie = itertools.count()\n65\t        for s in seeds:\n66\t            self._push(heap, qtok, s, \"\", 0, seen, tie)\n67\t        results: List[FetchedPage] = []\n68\t        while heap and len(results) < self.max_pages:\n69\t            _score, _t, url, depth = heapq.heappop(heap)\n70\t            host = self.scope.admit(url)\n71\t            if host is None:\n72\t                self.skips.append((url, \"out-of-scope\")); continue\n73\t            if per_host.get(host, 0) >= self.max_per_host:\n74\t                self.skips.append((url, \"per-host-cap\")); continue\n75\t            if not self.robots.can_fetch(url):\n76\t                self.skips.append((url, \"robots-disallow\")); continue     # RESPECT, never fetch\n77\t            self.rate.acquire(host, host_min=self.robots.crawl_delay(url))\n78\t            res = self._fetch(url)\n79\t            if not res.ok:\n80\t                self.skips.append((url, res.reason)); continue\n81\t            per_host[host] = per_host.get(host, 0) + 1\n82\t            page_links = extract.links(url, res.raw)\n83\t            results.append(FetchedPage(url=url, status=res.status, text=extract.main_text(res.raw),\n84\t                                       raw=res.raw, content_hash=sha256_hex(res.raw.encode(\"utf-8\", \"ignore\")),\n85\t                                       depth=depth, links=page_links))\n86\t            if depth < self.max_depth:\n87\t                for lk in page_links:\n88\t                    self._push(heap, qtok, lk[\"url\"], lk.get(\"text\", \"\"), depth + 1, seen, tie)\n89\t        return results\n90\t\n91\t    def _push(self, heap, qtok, url, anchor, depth, seen, tie):\n92\t        try:\n93\t            nu = _norm_url(url)\n94\t        except (ValueError, TypeError):\n95\t            return\n96\t        if nu in seen or not url.startswith((\"http://\", \"https://\")):\n97\t            return\n98\t        seen.add(nu)\n99\t        heapq.heappush(heap, (-_voi(qtok, url, anchor, depth), next(tie), url, depth))\n100\t"}]},"uuid":"08b199be-88d0-4c99-a78b-6a180f0c2c18","timestamp":"2026-07-18T20:58:41.512Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7a6077cd-b618-4bbc-ba4f-0a4dd5075619","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

DEFAULT is `NullRenderer` (returns \"\" — an honest\n3\tgap on a headless box). A `HeadlessRenderer` is a DATA-EGRESS + ATTACK surface (a browser follows\n4\tredirects, loads third-party subresources, runs attacker JS — bypassing the pinned-IP + no-redirect\n5\tSSRF gate), so it is OFF BY DEFAULT, owner-opt-in, re-vets the host with `is_public_host`, runs\n6\tcookieless/credential-free with the correlatable UA, blocks private-IP subresource loads, and — if\n7\tthat private-IP blocking cannot be enforced by the provider — stays a documented, disabled seam.\n8\t`needs_js` is the missing-capability signal that decides escalation (it is NOT a block signal).\"\"\"\n9\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n10\t\n11\timport re\n12\tfrom typing import Optional, Protocol, runtime_checkable\n13\t\n14\t_JS_APP_HINT = re.compile(r\"<div[^>]+id=[\\\"'](root|app|__next)[\\\"']\", re.I)\n15\t\n16\t\n17\t@runtime_checkable\n18\tclass RenderProvider(Protocol):\n19\t    egresses: bool\n20\t    def render(self, url: str) -> str: ...   # returns rendered HTML, or \"\" on failure/unavailable\n21\t\n22\t\n23\tclass NullRenderer:\n24\t    \"\"\"The default: no JS rendering. Honest empty (never a fabricated render).\"\"\"\n25\t    egresses = False\n26\t\n27\t    def render(self, url: str) -> str:\n28\t        return \"\"\n29\t\n30\t\n31\tdef needs_js(html: str, *, min_text: int = 200) -> bool:\n32\t    \"\"\"True when a page is a JS-app shell (near-empty server-rendered text but a root/app mount).\n33\t    A MISSING-CAPABILITY signal — deliberately disjoint from a block signal, so 'render to beat a\n34\t    block' is never a path.\"\"\"\n35\t    from ..agents.sources import _strip_html\n36\t    text = _strip_html(html or \"\")\n37\t    return len(text.strip()) < min_text and bool(_JS_APP_HINT.search(html or \"\"))\n38\t"}]},"uuid":"7e0cd21f-15a8-40e8-9890-d8e80f932828","timestamp":"2026-07-18T20:58:41.799Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a46a69e2-f320-44f3-8848-3f2923864756","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

The model's free-text `statement` is NEVER the authoritative content (a\n6\tred-team re-check proved a token-subset check over the statement is not entailment: an\n7\textractor can drop a negation or reorder words to invert meaning while staying a token\n8\tsubset). By certifying and serving the verbatim quote instead, a fabricated or inverted\n9\tstatement can never be presented as a grounded fact — the owner only ever sees their own words.\n10\t\n11\tA candidate GROUNDS iff:\n12\t  1. it cites ≥1 seq, every cited seq is inside the exact window fed to the extractor;\n13\t  2. its `quote` is verbatim in ≥1 cited record re-fetched from the spine (never the model's copy);\n14\t  3. the quote is SPECIFIC — it carries ≥2 salient (non-stopword) tokens, Unicode-aware, so a\n15\t     trivial common substring grounds nothing.\n16\t\n17\tThe gate can only ever DEMOTE; the model's confidence never enters. Anything that fails is\n18\trecorded honestly as commentary, never as a fact and never dropped.\"\"\"\n19\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n20\t\n21\timport re\n22\t\n23\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n24\tfrom .grounding import UNGROUNDED, ground_tag\n25\tfrom .models import CandidateFact, GateVerdict\n26\t\n27\t_WS = re.compile(r\"\\s+\")\n28\t# Unicode-aware: a token starts with a word char (letter/digit, any script) and may carry\n29\t# internal separators (dates 2026-07-20, versions v1.2, paths a/b). \\w is Unicode by default.\n30\t_TOKEN = re.compile(r\"[^\\W_][\\w'./-]*\", re.UNICODE)\n31\t\n32\t_STOPWORDS = frozenset({\n33\t    \"the\", \"and\", \"for\", \"with\", \"that\", \"this\", \"have\", \"has\", \"had\", \"was\", \"were\", \"are\",\n34\t    \"will\", \"would\", \"should\", \"could\", \"can\", \"but\", \"you\", \"your\", \"our\", \"their\",\n35\t    \"from\", \"into\", \"out\", \"about\", \"then\", \"than\", \"them\", \"they\", \"there\", \"here\",\n36\t    \"what\", \"when\", \"where\", \"which\", \"who\", \"how\", \"all\", \"any\", \"some\", \"get\", \"got\", \"let\",\n37\t    \"let's\", \"lets\", \"actually\", \"just\", \"now\", \"today\", \"yesterday\", \"tomorrow\", \"really\",\n38\t    \"very\", \"more\", \"most\", \"much\", \"many\", \"also\", \"like\", \"want\", \"need\", \"going\", \"gonna\",\n39\t})\n40\t\n41\tMIN_QUOTE_SALIENT = 2      # a quote below this is too trivial to ground a claim\n42\t\n43\t\n44\tdef _norm(text: str) -> str:\n45\t    return _WS.sub(\" \", (text or \"\")).strip().lower()\n46\t\n47\t\n48\tdef salient(text: str) -> set[str]:\n49\t    \"\"\"Unicode-aware salient tokens: ≥3 chars, not a stopword, punctuation-trimmed.\"\"\"\n50\t    out: set[str] = set()\n51\t    for t in _TOKEN.findall((text or \"\").casefold()):\n52\t        t = t.strip(\"._/-'\")\n53\t        if len(t) >= 3 and t not in _STOPWORDS:\n54\t            out.add(t)\n55\t    return out\n56\t\n57\t\n58\tdef _real_span(quote: str, record_text: str) -> str | None:\n59\t    \"\"\"Return the BYTE-verbatim span of `record_text` that `quote` matches (tolerant of\n60\t    whitespace/case differences in the model's copy), so the SERVED fact is the record's own\n61\t    bytes, not the model's transcription. None if not found.\"\"\"\n62\t    words = quote.split()\n63\t    if not words:\n64\t        return None\n65\t    pat = r\"\\s+\".join(re.escape(w) for w in words)\n66\t    m = re.search(pat, record_text, re.IGNORECASE)\n67\t    return m.group(0) if m else None\n68\t\n69\t\n70\tdef admit(cand: CandidateFact, window_seqs: set[int], store: SpineStore) -> GateVerdict:\n71\t    \"\"\"Re-execute the candidate's citation(s) and ground the VERBATIM QUOTE(s). A contradiction\n72\t    must verify ≥2 DISTINCT records (evidence from both sides); every other kind needs ≥1. The\n73\t    served `text` is the record's own byte-verbatim span(s). Any failure → UNGROUNDED.\"\"\"\n74\t    if not cand.source_seqs:\n75\t        return GateVerdict(False, UNGROUNDED, [], \"cites no source records — cannot ground\")\n76\t\n77\t    outside = sorted({s for s in cand.source_seqs if s not in window_seqs})\n78\t    if outside:\n79\t        return GateVerdict(False, UNGROUNDED, [],\n80\t                           f\"cites seq(s) outside the fed window {outside} — fabricated citation\")\n81\t\n82\t    quotes = [q for q in (cand.quotes or (cand.quote,)) if q and q.strip()]\n83\t    if not quotes:\n84\t        return GateVerdict(False, UNGROUNDED, [], \"no quote to verify\")\n85\t\n86\t    verified: set[int] = set()\n87\t    spans: list[str] = []\n88\t    for qq in quotes:\n89\t        if len(salient(qq)) < MIN_QUOTE_SALIENT:\n90\t            continue                                          # a trivial quote grounds nothing\n91\t        qn = _norm(qq)\n92\t        for s in cand.source_seqs:\n93\t            rec = store.get(s)\n94\t            if rec is not None and s not in verified and qn in _norm(rec.text()):\n95\t                verified.add(s)\n96\t                spans.append(_real_span(qq, rec.text()) or qq)\n97\t                break\n98\t    if not verified:\n99\t        return GateVerdict(False, UNGROUNDED, [],\n100\t                           \"no quote is verbatim-and-specific in any cited record — fabricated/trivial quote\")\n101\t\n102\t    need = 2 if cand.kind == \"contradiction\" else 1\n103\t    if len(verified) < need:\n104\t        return GateVerdict(False, UNGROUNDED, [],\n105\t                           f\"a {cand.kind} needs ≥{need} distinct records to verbatim-verify — only {len(verified)} did\")\n106\t\n107\t    vs = sorted(verified)\n108\t    return GateVerdict(True, ground_tag(min(vs)), vs,\n109\t                       f\"grounded: {len(vs)} verbatim record span(s) at seq(s) {vs}\",\n110\t                       text=\" || \".join(spans))\n111\t"}]},"uuid":"a5fd51bc-68d7-4922-b485-aebd250c0b01","timestamp":"2026-07-18T20:58:52.887Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"386a652b-03bc-4a0e-baeb-6538e8a68203","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Offense-free personal-memory analogue of the\n2\tCRUCIBLE recon vocabulary — a candidate fact an extractor proposes, and the gate's verdict.\n3\t\n4\tA `CandidateFact` is a PROPOSAL, never a fact. It becomes a fact only if `gate.admit`\n5\tre-executes its citation successfully; otherwise it is recorded honestly as a refusal. The\n6\tmodel's `model_confidence` can only ever LOWER effective ranking — it never promotes.\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\n10\t\n11\t\n12\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n13\tclass CandidateFact:\n14\t    \"\"\"A candidate durable fact proposed by an ExtractionProvider over spine records.\n15\t\n16\t    `quote` MUST be a verbatim span copied from one of the `source_seqs` records — the gate\n17\t    re-fetches those records and refuses to ground anything whose quote it cannot find.\"\"\"\n18\t    kind: str                       # \"decision\" | \"commitment\" | \"entity\" | \"contradiction\"\n19\t    subject: str                    # canonical subject/key (what this fact is ABOUT)\n20\t    statement: str                  # advisory summary in the owner's terms (NEVER the served fact)\n21\t    quote: str                      # verbatim span from a cited record (the ground)\n22\t    source_seqs: list[int]          # spine seqs the extractor cited\n23\t    model_confidence: float = 0.5   # DEMOTE-ONLY: may lower ranking, never promote\n24\t    owner: str | None = None        # commitments: who is on the hook\n25\t    due_iso: str | None = None      # commitments: due date (ISO), if any\n26\t    extractor: str = \"unknown\"      # provenance of the proposal (heuristic | agent | replay)\n27\t    quotes: tuple[str, ...] = ()    # contradictions: a verbatim quote from EACH conflicting record\n28\t\n29\t    def key_fields(self) -> dict:\n30\t        # identity is the GROUNDED content (the verbatim quote/quotes), not the model's\n31\t        # paraphrase — so two reaffirmations quoting the same span dedupe. Commitments also key\n32\t        # on owner/due (canonicalized) so a CHANGED deadline is a new promotion, not a duplicate.\n33\t        content = \" \".join((self.quote or \"\").split()).casefold()\n34\t        if self.quotes:\n35\t            content = \" || \".join(sorted(\" \".join(q.split()).casefold() for q in self.quotes))\n36\t        base = {\"kind\": self.kind, \"subject\": self.subject.strip().lower(), \"content\": content}\n37\t        if self.kind == \"commitment\":\n38\t            base[\"owner\"] = (self.owner or \"\").strip().casefold()\n39\t            base[\"due_iso\"] = (self.due_iso or \"\").strip()\n40\t        return base\n41\t\n42\t\n43\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n44\tclass GateVerdict:\n45\t    \"\"\"The sole admission authority's decision — decided by RE-EXECUTION, not model text.\"\"\"\n46\t    grounded: bool\n47\t    grounding: str                  # \"ingest:seq=<n>\" (grounded) | \"llm:ungrounded\" (demoted)\n48\t    verified_seqs: list[int] = field(default_factory=list)\n49\t    reason: str = \"\"\n50\t    text: str = \"\"                  # the BYTE-verbatim record span(s) — the served fact content\n51\t"}]},"uuid":"0f863b84-d399-401e-98db-cf3222e99de9","timestamp":"2026-07-18T20:58:59.756Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a5facac8-a1da-48e4-ae35-0a9d2916e2f0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"8104e06d-e172-43fa-bcf1-e1f923d3e80b","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"15d22289-34bd-4b16-93d1-385f77b75827","agentId":"a9e8a9e63299e0444","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01EpCMAxusuagy8MkENmJYfa","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"SCHOLAR (SIGIL §4.5) — research & analysis: long-horizon research, sourced synthesis. Ceiling\n2\tA1 (research never touches external state). Its focus is EPISTEMICS: every claim carries a\n3\tsource and a verbatim quote, confidence is explicit, and a claim that does NOT verify against its\n4\tcited source is DEMOTED (not asserted) — the same serve-the-quote gate that governs the\n5\tconsolidation, reused here. The output is a `report` record grounded in real sources, so future\n6\trecall of the research is cited and honest, not confident. The synthesizer is pluggable\n7\t(`ClaudeSynthesizer` via `claude -p`, or a deterministic double).\"\"\"\n8\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n9\t\n10\timport json\n11\timport re\n12\timport subprocess\n13\tfrom typing import Dict, List, Optional, Protocol, runtime_checkable\n14\t\n15\tfrom ..consolidate.gate import salient   # reuse the veracity tokenizer\n16\tfrom .base import Agent, AgentResult, Proposal, Tier\n17\tfrom .sources import read_source\n18\t\n19\t_WS = re.compile(r\"\\s+\")\n20\t_MIN_QUOTE_SALIENT = 2\n21\t\n22\t\n23\tdef _norm(t: str) -> str:\n24\t    return _WS.sub(\" \", (t or \"\")).strip().lower()\n25\t\n26\t\n27\tdef grounds_in_source(quote: str, source_text: str) -> bool:\n28\t    \"\"\"A claim's quote must be verbatim in the cited source AND specific (≥2 salient tokens) —\n29\t    exactly the serve-the-quote discipline, applied to research sources.\"\"\"\n30\t    q = _norm(quote)\n31\t    if not q or len(salient(quote)) < _MIN_QUOTE_SALIENT:\n32\t        return False\n33\t    return q in _norm(source_text)\n34\t\n35\t\n36\t@runtime_checkable\n37\tclass Synthesizer(Protocol):\n38\t    def synthesize(self, question: str, docs: Dict[str, str]) -> List[dict]: ...  # [{claim,source,quote,confidence}]\n39\t\n40\t\n41\tclass ClaudeSynthesizer:\n42\t    \"\"\"`claude -p` over the sources → JSON claims, each citing a source ref + a verbatim quote.\"\"\"\n43\t    def __init__(self, claude_bin: str = \"/home/kali/.local/bin/claude\",\n44\t                 model: str = \"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001\", timeout: int = 180):\n45\t        self.claude_bin, self.model, self.timeout = claude_bin, model, timeout\n46\t\n47\t    def synthesize(self, question: str, docs: Dict[str, str]) -> List[dict]:\n48\t        rendered = \"\\n\\n\".join(f\"[SOURCE {ref}]\\n{text[:4000]}\" for ref, text in docs.items())\n49\t        prompt = (\n50\t            \"You are a research analyst. Answer the QUESTION using ONLY the SOURCES. For every claim, \"\n51\t            \"cite the exact source ref and copy a VERBATIM quote from it that supports the claim; if a \"\n52\t            \"source does not support a claim, do not make it. If sources DISAGREE, report both. Return \"\n53\t            'ONLY a JSON array: [{\"claim\":\"...\",\"source\":\"<ref>\",\"quote\":\"<verbatim>\",\"confidence\":<0..1>}].'\n54\t            f\"\\n\\nQUESTION: {question}\\n\\nSOURCES:\\n{rendered}\\n\"\n55\t        )\n56\t        try:\n57\t            proc = subprocess.run([self.claude_bin, \"-p\", prompt, \"--model\", self.model],\n58\t                                  capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=self.timeout)\n59\t        except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n60\t            return []\n61\t        m = re.search(r\"\\[.*\\]\", proc.stdout, re.S)\n62\t        if not m:\n63\t            return []\n64\t        try:\n65\t            items = json.loads(m.group(0))\n66\t        except json.JSONDecodeError:\n67\t            return []\n68\t        out = []\n69\t        for it in items if isinstance(items, list) else []:\n70\t            if isinstance(it, dict) and it.get(\"claim\") and it.get(\"source\"):\n71\t                out.append({\"claim\": str(it[\"claim\"]), \"source\": str(it[\"source\"]),\n72\t                            \"quote\": str(it.get(\"quote\", \"\")), \"confidence\": float(it.get(\"confidence\", 0.5) or 0.5)})\n73\t        return out\n74\t\n75\t\n76\tdef compose_report(question: str, graded: List[dict], sources: List[str]) -> str:\n77\t    grounded = [g for g in graded if g[\"grounded\"]]\n78\t    lines = [f\"# SCHOLAR research — {question}\", \"\",\n79\t             f\"Sources consulted: {len(sources)}. Claims: {len(graded)} \"\n80\t             f\"({len(grounded)} source-verified, {len(graded) - len(grounded)} unverified).\", \"\"]\n81\t    if grounded:\n82\t        # SERVE THE QUOTE, not the model's claim: the authoritative content is the verbatim source\n83\t        # span (which is what actually verified). The model's claim is advisory ONLY — a fabricated\n84\t        # claim paired with a real quote must NOT be presented as a source-verified fact.\n85\t        lines.append(\"## Source-verified spans (the authoritative evidence, verbatim)\")\n86\t        for g in sorted(grounded, key=lambda x: -x[\"confidence\"]):\n87\t            lines.append(f\"- \\\"{g['quote'][:200]}\\\"\")\n88\t            lines.append(f\"    — {g['source']}  ·  model's reading (ADVISORY, not verified): \"\n89\t                         f\"{g['claim'][:120]}  [{g['confidence']:.0%}]\")\n90\t    ungrounded = [g for g in graded if not g[\"grounded\"]]\n91\t    if ungrounded:\n92\t        lines.append(\"\\n## Unverified (the model asserted these but no verbatim source span backs them — NOT relied upon)\")\n93\t        for g in ungrounded:\n94\t            lines.append(f\"- {g['claim'][:120]}  (claimed source {g['source']})\")\n95\t    return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n96\t\n97\t\n98\tclass Scholar(Agent):\n99\t    name = \"SCHOLAR\"\n100\t    mandate = \"sourced research; claims carry sources + confidence; disagreement reported, not averaged\"\n101\t    ceiling = Tier.A1\n102\t\n103\t    def run(self, question: str, sources: List[str], *, synthesizer: Optional[Synthesizer] = None) -> AgentResult:\n104\t        docs = {ref: read_source(ref) for ref in sources}\n105\t        claims = (synthesizer or ClaudeSynthesizer()).synthesize(question, docs)\n106\t        graded = [{**c, \"grounded\": grounds_in_source(c.get(\"quote\", \"\"), docs.get(c[\"source\"], \"\"))}\n107\t                  for c in claims]\n108\t        text = compose_report(question, graded, sources)\n109\t        g = sum(1 for x in graded if x[\"grounded\"])\n110\t        res = self._dispatch([Proposal(\"report\", {\n111\t            \"subject\": question, \"text\": text, \"sources\": sources,\n112\t            \"claims\": len(graded), \"grounded\": g}, Tier.A1)])\n113\t        res.notes.append(f\"researched '{question[:50]}' over {len(sources)} source(s): \"\n114\t                         f\"{g}/{len(graded)} claims source-verified\")\n115\t        return res\n116\t"}]},"uuid":"8b75b1fd-e24e-4f2f-b0a3-62b0a873edf8","timestamp":"2026-07-18T20:59:24.920Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"8104e06d-e172-43fa-bcf1-e1f923d3e80b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"19b69fa8-191e-4ad2-be1d-4c6649b9aede","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"15d22289-34bd-4b16-93d1-385f77b75827","agentId":"a9e8a9e63299e0444","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Dx12yp3YoESGbdrV8hEd5b","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Grounding taxonomy + domain-neutral Beta belief math (SIGIL §6.3, ported from\n2\tworldmodel/models.py). Grounding is queryable METADATA that never moves belief; belief is a\n3\tBeta(alpha,beta) whose mean/LCB only ever drop on refutation (demote-only).\"\"\"\n4\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n5\t\n6\timport math\n7\t\n8\t# the source stamped on every consolidation-written record (distinguishes it from ingest).\n9\tCONSOLIDATE_SOURCE = \"archivist\"\n10\t\n11\t# grounding tags. A record is a FACT only if its grounding starts with GROUNDED_PREFIX.\n12\tGROUNDED_PREFIX = \"ingest:\"          # traces to real spine records that re-verified\n13\tUNGROUNDED = \"llm:ungrounded\"        # the model asserted it but re-execution failed → commentary\n14\t\n15\t\n16\tdef ground_tag(min_seq: int) -> str:\n17\t    return f\"{GROUNDED_PREFIX}seq={min_seq}\"\n18\t\n19\t\n20\tdef is_grounded(grounding: str | None) -> bool:\n21\t    return bool(grounding) and grounding.startswith(GROUNDED_PREFIX)\n22\t\n23\t\n24\tdef belief_mean(alpha: float, beta: float) -> float:\n25\t    a, b = max(1e-9, alpha), max(1e-9, beta)\n26\t    return a / (a + b)\n27\t\n28\t\n29\tdef belief_lcb(alpha: float, beta: float, z: float = 1.0) -> float:\n30\t    \"\"\"Lower confidence bound = mean − z·sd of Beta(alpha,beta). A wide, low-support belief\n31\t    has a collapsed LCB even when its mean looks acceptable (the consistency.py insight).\"\"\"\n32\t    a, b = max(1e-9, alpha), max(1e-9, beta)\n33\t    mean = a / (a + b)\n34\t    var = (a * b) / ((a + b) ** 2 * (a + b + 1.0))\n35\t    return max(0.0, mean - z * math.sqrt(var))\n36\t"}]},"uuid":"1ad13331-f37b-41e7-9aa1-720414a43a4a","timestamp":"2026-07-18T20:59:25.259Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"19b69fa8-191e-4ad2-be1d-4c6649b9aede","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"1cf1dcf4-ab2a-4755-aac1-27b646332764","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"15d22289-34bd-4b16-93d1-385f77b75827","agentId":"a9e8a9e63299e0444","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_018dJrYcM2EBLqiYLnsqezrR","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The SIGIL agent mesh framework (SIGIL §4/§5). Each agent has a MANDATE and an AUTONOMY\n2\tCEILING (A0–A3); everything it does is a `Proposal` carrying a tier. Proposals at or below the\n3\tauto bar (A1) and at or below the agent's ceiling are AUTO-APPLIED (written to the spine);\n4\tanything higher is QUEUED as a pending record a human must approve — never auto-executed.\n5\t\n6\tThe doctrine is enforced STRUCTURALLY, not by discipline: an agent literally cannot take an\n7\texternal-effect action, because no agent has a send/deploy/spend code path. ENVOY, in\n8\tparticular, drafts only — its ceiling is A2 and there is no method that transmits. Agent output\n9\tis provenance-linked spine records, so a brief or a draft is auditable back to what produced it.\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\n13\tfrom enum import IntEnum\n14\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n15\t\n16\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n17\t\n18\tAGENTS_SOURCE = \"agent\"\n19\t\n20\t\n21\tclass Tier(IntEnum):\n22\t    \"\"\"Mirror of the WARDEN tiers (SIGIL §5), ordered so `<=` compares autonomy.\"\"\"\n23\t    A0 = 0   # observe / answer\n24\t    A1 = 1   # reversible internal act (write a report/brief/event) — the AUTO bar\n25\t    A2 = 2   # external-visible / semi-reversible (send, calendar write) — QUEUED\n26\t    A3 = 3   # destructive / financial / security — explicit, never auto\n27\t\n28\t    def label(self) -> str:\n29\t        return self.name\n30\t\n31\t\n32\tAUTO_BAR = Tier.A1  # A0/A1 auto-apply; A2/A3 queue for human approval\n33\t\n34\t\n35\t@dataclass\n36\tclass Proposal:\n37\t    \"\"\"One thing an agent wants to do: emit a record (auto) or take a gated action (queued).\"\"\"\n38\t    kind: str                       # spine record kind (event/finding/brief/interaction/draft/...)\n39\t    payload: dict\n40\t    tier: Tier = Tier.A1\n41\t    parent_id: Optional[int] = None\n42\t    supersedes_id: Optional[int] = None   # this record supersedes an earlier one (e.g. a resolution)\n43\t\n44\t\n45\t@dataclass\n46\tclass AgentResult:\n47\t    agent: str\n48\t    applied: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)     # seqs written (auto)\n49\t    queued: List[dict] = field(default_factory=list)      # proposals held for approval\n50\t    notes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n51\t\n52\t\n53\tclass Agent:\n54\t    \"\"\"Base agent. Subclasses implement `run()`; the base routes every Proposal through the GOVERNOR\n55\t    (SIGIL §5: kill switch, budgets, promotion — Phase 6) and records the outcome on the spine.\n56\t    Backward compatible: with no kill/cap/promotion the governor reproduces the original gate.\"\"\"\n57\t    name: str = \"AGENT\"\n58\t    mandate: str = \"\"\n59\t    ceiling: Tier = Tier.A1\n60\t\n61\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, governor=None):\n62\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n63\t        if governor is None:\n64\t            from ..governor import Governor\n65\t            governor = Governor(self.store)\n66\t        self.governor = governor\n67\t\n68\t    def run(self) -> AgentResult:\n69\t        raise NotImplementedError\n70\t\n71\t    def _dispatch(self, proposals: List[Proposal]) -> AgentResult:\n72\t        from ..governor import Outcome\n73\t        res = AgentResult(agent=self.name)\n74\t        for p in proposals:\n75\t            effective = max(p.tier, Tier.A0)\n76\t            # promotion scope = the RECORD KIND (the real action written), not a self-asserted label:\n77\t            # a promotion is \"this agent may auto-approve A2 records of this kind\" (red-pen RP-3).\n78\t            decision = self.governor.decide(agent=self.name, tier=effective,\n79\t                                            ceiling=self.ceiling, scope=p.kind)\n80\t            common = {**p.payload, \"agent\": self.name, \"tier\": effective.label(),\n81\t                      \"governor\": decision.reason}\n82\t            if decision.outcome == Outcome.AUTO:\n83\t                seq = self.store.append(kind=p.kind, source=AGENTS_SOURCE, actor=self.name,\n84\t                                        payload={**common, \"decision\": \"auto\"},\n85\t                                        parent_id=p.parent_id, supersedes_id=p.supersedes_id)\n86\t                res.applied.append(seq)\n87\t            elif decision.outcome == Outcome.QUEUE:\n88\t                seq = self.store.append(kind=p.kind, source=AGENTS_SOURCE, actor=self.name,\n89\t                                        payload={**common, \"decision\": \"queued\", \"status\": \"awaiting-approval\"},\n90\t                                        parent_id=p.parent_id, supersedes_id=p.supersedes_id)\n91\t                res.queued.append({\"seq\": seq, \"kind\": p.kind, \"tier\": effective.label(),\n92\t                                   \"subject\": p.payload.get(\"subject\") or p.payload.get(\"to\")})\n93\t            else:  # DENY — kill switch or budget; record the refusal, take no action\n94\t                self.store.append(kind=\"refusal\", source=AGENTS_SOURCE, actor=self.name,\n95\t                                  payload={\"agent\": self.name, \"tier\": effective.label(),\n96\t                                           \"decision\": \"denied\", \"governor\": decision.reason,\n97\t                                           \"of_kind\": p.kind, \"subject\": p.payload.get(\"subject\")},\n98\t                                  parent_id=p.parent_id)\n99\t                res.notes.append(f\"DENIED {p.kind} ({effective.label()}): {decision.reason}\")\n100\t        return res\n101\t"}]},"uuid":"72b2923d-700f-4e92-899b-6b59344bf5cd","timestamp":"2026-07-18T20:59:31.518Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"1cf1dcf4-ab2a-4755-aac1-27b646332764","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"3f7521a9-164d-403a-9137-5b6c54725af9","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"15d22289-34bd-4b16-93d1-385f77b75827","agentId":"a9e8a9e63299e0444","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01EmCKt6RTgvr5nNCyUunEKT","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Append-only, hash-chained JSONL spine (SIGIL §6.1, D1).\n2\t\n3\tReuses CRUCIBLE's tamper-evident chain verbatim (`sigil.reuse`): each line carries\n4\t`{seq, prev_hash, entry_hash}` where `entry_hash` links prev+cert_digest+seq. The\n5\t`cert_digest` is over the record's CONTENT only (scope/kind/source/actor/payload/\n6\tparent/supersedes) — NOT the wallclock `ts` — so the chain is replay-stable. Appends\n7\tare O(1): read the last line's entry, `append_entry`, write.\n8\t\"\"\"\n9\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n10\t\n11\timport json\n12\timport os\n13\tfrom pathlib import Path\n14\tfrom typing import Any, Iterator\n15\t\n16\tfrom ..config import SCOPE, SPINE_PATH\n17\tfrom ..reuse import ChainEntry, append_entry, build_chain, digest_payload, verify_chain\n18\tfrom .models import SpineRecord, now_iso\n19\t\n20\t\n21\tdef _last_nonempty_line(path: Path) -> str | None:\n22\t    \"\"\"Read the last non-empty line without loading the file (seek-from-end).\"\"\"\n23\t    with path.open(\"rb\") as f:\n24\t        f.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)\n25\t        end = f.tell()\n26\t        if end == 0:\n27\t            return None\n28\t        buf = b\"\"\n29\t        pos = end\n30\t        while pos > 0:\n31\t            step = min(8192, pos)\n32\t            pos -= step\n33\t            f.seek(pos)\n34\t            buf = f.read(step) + buf\n35\t            lines = [ln for ln in buf.split(b\"\\n\") if ln.strip()]\n36\t            if lines and (pos == 0 or buf.count(b\"\\n\") >= 2):\n37\t                return lines[-1].decode(\"utf-8\")\n38\t        lines = [ln for ln in buf.split(b\"\\n\") if ln.strip()]\n39\t        return lines[-1].decode(\"utf-8\") if lines else None\n40\t\n41\t\n42\tclass SpineStore:\n43\t    def __init__(self, path: Path | str = SPINE_PATH) -> None:\n44\t        self.path = Path(path)\n45\t        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n46\t        self._last: ChainEntry | None = self._read_last_entry()\n47\t\n48\t    # --- write --------------------------------------------------------------------\n49\t    def append(\n50\t        self, *, kind: str, source: str, actor: str, payload: dict[str, Any],\n51\t        parent_id: int | None = None, supersedes_id: int | None = None,\n52\t        ts: str | None = None,\n53\t    ) -> int:\n54\t        content = {\n55\t            \"scope\": SCOPE, \"kind\": kind, \"source\": source, \"actor\": actor,\n56\t            \"payload\": payload, \"parent_id\": parent_id, \"supersedes_id\": supersedes_id,\n57\t        }\n58\t        cert_digest = digest_payload(content)  # wallclock-free\n59\t        entry = append_entry([self._last], cert_digest) if self._last else build_chain([cert_digest])[0]\n60\t        record = {\n61\t            \"seq\": entry.seq, **content, \"ts\": ts or now_iso(),\n62\t            \"cert_digest\": cert_digest, \"prev_hash\": entry.prev_hash, \"entry_hash\": entry.entry_hash,\n63\t        }\n64\t        with self.path.open(\"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n65\t            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\")\n66\t        self._last = entry\n67\t        return entry.seq\n68\t\n69\t    # --- read ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n70\t    def iter_records(self, *, since_seq: int = -1) -> Iterator[SpineRecord]:\n71\t        if not self.path.exists():\n72\t            return\n73\t        with self.path.open(encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n74\t            for line in f:\n75\t                line = line.strip()\n76\t                if not line:\n77\t                    continue\n78\t                d = json.loads(line)\n79\t                if d[\"seq\"] > since_seq:\n80\t                    yield SpineRecord.from_dict(d)\n81\t\n82\t    def get(self, seq: int) -> SpineRecord | None:\n83\t        for r in self.iter_records(since_seq=seq - 1):\n84\t            if r.seq == seq:\n85\t                return r\n86\t            if r.seq > seq:\n87\t                break\n88\t        return None\n89\t\n90\t    @property\n91\t    def next_seq(self) -> int:\n92\t        return (self._last.seq + 1) if self._last else 0\n93\t\n94\t    def count(self) -> int:\n95\t        return sum(1 for _ in self.iter_records())\n96\t\n97\t    # --- integrity ----------------------------------------------------------------\n98\t    def entries(self) -> list[ChainEntry]:\n99\t        return [\n100\t            ChainEntry(seq=r.seq, prev_hash=r.prev_hash, cert_digest=r.cert_digest, entry_hash=r.entry_hash)\n101\t            for r in self.iter_records()\n102\t        ]\n103\t\n104\t    def verify(self) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n105\t        \"\"\"Two-layer UNKEYED integrity: (1) BINDING — each record's payload still hashes to its\n106\t        stored cert_digest (catches silent payload edits); (2) CHAIN — the entries link cleanly\n107\t        (catches delete/reorder/entry tamper). This proves internal CONSISTENCY, not authenticity:\n108\t        a naive payload edit fails (1), and a mid-chain digest edit cascades an entry_hash/prev_hash\n109\t        break caught by (2) — BUT a writer who recomputes cert_digest+entry_hash for the tip (no\n110\t        successor to cascade into) or forward-cascades a fork produces a self-consistent chain that\n111\t        passes here. Resistance to a recompute-capable writer is the owner-SIGNED head's job\n112\t        (`checkpoint.verify_checkpoint`, Ed25519 + monotonic last_seq).
